Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Companion Playbook Stage: Adds a dedicated interactive playbook screen after home_intro demonstrating how to summon, drag, and talk to the desktop pet. (why: Support received 3 emails about users being unclear on how to control, hide, or talk to their pet post-onboarding.)
1: [sign_in, new_flow] Pet Recovery Pin Account Safeguard Flow: Introduces an account recovery PIN creation option on the sign-in step to ensure pet state persistence across sessions. (why: 8 support emails reported pets missing or reset after signing in again, making account recovery confidence critical during sign in.)
2: [finish, hint] Desktop Taskbar Pinning Visual Guide: Displays an animated visual callout on the home_intro screen showing how to pin the pet app to the taskbar and system tray. (why: 3 support emails reported pets not showing on desktop or apps not opening after onboarding.)
3: [choose_path, copy] Path Outcome Clarity Headline Update: Rewrites path selection headlines to clearly explain the difference between choosing a preset pet vs creating a custom photo pet. (why: 3 support emails cited custom pet generation looking wrong or failing, requiring clear expectations upfront at path selection.)
4: [home, notification] Desktop Engine Ready Audio Banner: Adds an opt-in audio chime notification toggle on the waiting screen when desktop asset compilation finishes. (why: Waiting step mean time is 2336s (38 mins), indicating users alt-tab away and miss when rendering completes.)
5: [choose_path, layout] Story Scroll Feature Spotlight Layout: Updates the story intro screen layout to a centered spotlight highlighting key desktop pet capabilities. (why: choose_path mean time is 514s, showing users hesitate early when digesting initial app concepts.)
